name: Hat - Embroidered Hemp Leaf Snapback
description:
Make a statement with the OCHO Extracts Embroidered Hemp Leaf Snapback. Featuring a structured cap with bold raised embroidery logo detailing and red hemp plant accent, this snapback blends clean streetwear styling with standout contrast.

Built with an adjustable snapback closure for a comfortable fit, this piece is designed for everyday wear while adding a pop of color and personality to any fit. The raised embroidery finish adds premium texture and elevated detail to the overall design.

Features:

• Raised embroidered white and red logo detailing

• Raised red embroidered hemp leaf accent

• 
Structured snapback construction

• Adjustable snapback closure

• Black or beige cap colorway

• Slightly curved brim styling

• One size fits most
